Priya (AE): Hey team — Weston Insurance POC kickoff. They want SAML SSO, SCIM user sync (groups + role mapping), strict tenant isolation per business unit, and answers on session retention and audit logs. Also price diff between Dedicated vs Private for regulated PII. Can someone confirm our capabilities and any known blockers? @Sam @Maya
Sam (Solutions Eng): Quick list: we support SAML (IdP-initiated + SP-initiated), SCIM 2.0 for users & groups, RBAC via attribute/role-mapping, and per-tenant VPC/network isolation on Private. For Dedicated we can do isolated GPU pools but control plane is shared.
Maya (Security): Security notes: Private = customer-managed control plane + optional HSM/KMS for keys. Audit logs stored for 365d by default (can extend). We do not persist raw tokens; session artifacts are ephemeral but we keep auth events. Need to confirm retention length Weston wants.
Jon (Sales Eng): Pricing: rough ballpark — Dedicated starts at $Xk/month for reserved capacity (depending on vGPU size). Private has a platform fee + infra estimate (on-prem or VPC). I'll pull exact numbers once we lock expected qps/throughput.
Elena (Weston IT): A few specifics from our InfoSec: 1) Domain proof must be DNS TXT (company policy). 2) We use ADFS — SAML assertions need 12h validity window. 3) SCIM must be able to go through an on-prem connector (we can't open SCIM directly to internet). 4) Need RBAC to allow only BU admins to create users in their tenant.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Re: ADFS — we support longer assertion lifetimes; we usually recommend signing config adjustments on IdP side. For SCIM via on-prem connector we recommend deploying our SCIM bridge (lightweight connector) inside their network that tunnels to Redwood Private control plane — works for both Private and Dedicated with extra network config. Example SCIM PATCH for group assign: ```PATCH /scim/v2/Groups/{id} Content-Type: application/json { "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"], "Operations": [{"op":"add", "path":"members", "value":[{"value":"12345","display":"alice@weston.com"}]}] }```
Maya (Security): Compliance: we have SOC2 Type II and ISO27001 certs; for Private we can surface audit logs to their SIEM (syslog/ELK/forwarder). Encryption at rest with customer-managed keys is available in Private. Also need to confirm legal requirements for data residency.
LegalBot: From security questionnaire perspective: Q12 (user provisioning): answer = SCIM 2.0 with connector. Q18 (session retention): default 0-7 days for session tokens, events logged 365 days. Provide SOC2 report under NDA.
Priya (AE): Noted. @Jon — can you attach Dedicated vs Private pricing matrix and lead times? @Maya — can you confirm whether HSM option is GA for Private or still gated?
Jon (Sales Eng): I'll drop an initial pricing matrix by EOD. Lead times: Dedicated reserved capacity ~2–4 weeks provisioning; Private (VPC) ~4–6 weeks for standard setup, on-prem longer depending on infra.
Maya (Security): HSM integration is GA for Private in cloud VPC deployments, on-prem HSM setup requires extra config but supported. I'll write a short blurb for the RFI.
Elena (Weston IT): Also: can we get a short runbook for failover? We need to show how auth continuity works if control plane connectivity drops.
deploy-bot: Note: sample deploy for SCIM-bridge image available at registry.redwood.com/scim-bridge:stable; ci pipeline job #4721 created for connector test.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Runbook high level: 1) SCIM bridge retries + local queueing, 2) Local AD sync fallback (read-only) for auth, 3) Fallback to cached sessions for 15 minutes. I'll draft more detail.
Priya (AE): Action items: 1) Jon — pricing matrix + lead times (EOD). 2) Maya — HSM + audit/logs blurb + RFI answers (tomorrow). 3) Sam — SCIM-bridge runbook + sample config for ADFS + example RBAC mapping (tomorrow morning). 4) LegalBot — sample SOC2 NDA blurb. 5) Elena — confirm required retention and connector network constraints. I'll schedule a call for Friday 10am PT. :calendar:
Elena (Weston IT): Friday 10am PT works. Thanks all.
Priya (AE): Great, I'll send invite and attach the prep doc (incl checklist and sample SCIM payloads).
